**Summary of Work So Far:**

- **Analyzed Codebase**: Reviewed `parse.py` thoroughly, noting current structure, exports (`__all__`), key classes (`Parser`, `Result`, `Match`, `FixedTzOffset`, `int_convert`, etc.), and utility functions (`extract_format`, `date_convert`, `with_pattern`).
- **Verified Existing Tests**: Ran the 79 existing unit tests; all passed successfully.
- **Identified Requirements**: Mapped out six specific requirements ([R1]-[R6]) covering new public API exposure (`dt_format_to_regex`), structural preservation (`FixedTzOffset`, `RepeatedNameError`, etc.), new properties (`Formatter`), datetime precision fixes (`%f`), field name flexibility (hyphens), and decimal grouping support.

**What is Pending:**
- Implementation of `dt_format_to_regex` function and related regex generation utilities.
- Modifications to the `Parser` class to support single-digit days/months, colon-containing time formats, and flexible `%z` timezone parsing.
- Addition of a `formatter` property to the `Parser` class.
- Updates to `%f` directive handling to support variable-length fractional seconds.
- Adjustments to field name validation to allow hyphen-minus characters.
- Enhancements to decimal number parsing to recognize grouping characters (commas and underscores).
- Updating `__all__` exports to include the new public symbols.
- Final verification that all existing tests continue to pass alongside any new hidden tests.

No tool calls needed at this stage as I am ready to begin implementation.
